<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0;color:#212529;background-color:#FFFFFF'><B>&#160;</B></P>
<P style='font:10pt revert-layer;margin:0;color:#212529;background-color:#FFFFFF'>&#8201;</P>
<P style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0;color:#212529;background-color:#FFFFFF'><FONT style=font-family:revert-layer><B>ITEM 4.01. Changes in Registrant's Certifying Accountant.</B></FONT></P>
<P style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0;color:#212529;background-color:#FFFFFF'>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0;color:#212529;background-color:#FFFFFF'>On&#160;February 27, 2026, FRUCI &amp; ASSOCIATES II, PLLC was dismissed as the Company's independent registered public accounting firm. FRUCI &amp; ASSOCIATES II, PLLC, has submitted his resignation letter herein. </P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0;color:#212529;background-color:#FFFFFF'>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0;color:#212529;background-color:#FFFFFF'>The reports of FRUCI &amp; ASSOCIATES II, PLLC on the Company's financial statements for the two fiscal years ended April 30, 2025, and through February 27, 2026, did not contain an adverse opinion or a disclaimer of opinion, and were not qualified or modified as to uncertainty, audit scope, or accounting principles. However, the reports for these periods did contain an explanatory paragraph concerning the Company's potential inability to continue as a going concern.</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0;color:#212529;background-color:#FFFFFF'>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0;color:#212529;background-color:#FFFFFF'>During the two fiscal years ended April 30, 2025 and through&#160;February 27, 2026, there have been no &#8220;disagreements&#8221; (as defined in Item&#160;304(a)(1)(iv) of Regulation S-K and related instructions) with FRUCI &amp; ASSOCIATES II, PLLC on any matter of accounting principles or practices, financial statement disclosure, or auditing scope or procedure, which disagreements if not resolved to the satisfaction of FRUCI &amp; ASSOCIATES II, PLLC would have caused FRUCI &amp; ASSOCIATES II, PLLC to make reference thereto in its reports on the financial statements for such years. During the two fiscal years ended April 30, 2025, through February 27, 2026, The Company's disclosed material weaknesses in ICFR (lack of segregation of duties, lack of multi-level review, and over-reliance on external reporting consultants) are reportable events under Item 304(a)(1)(v)(A).</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0;color:#212529;background-color:#FFFFFF'>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0;color:#212529;background-color:#FFFFFF'>The Company provided FRUCI &amp; ASSOCIATES II, PLLC with a copy of the disclosure it is making herein and requested that FRUCI &amp; ASSOCIATES II, PLLC furnish the Company with a copy of its letter addressed to the Securities and Exchange Commission (the &#8220;SEC&#8221;), stating whether or not FRUCI &amp; ASSOCIATES II, PLLC agrees with the statements related to them made by the Company in this report. </P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0;color:#212529;background-color:#FFFFFF'>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0;color:#212529;background-color:#FFFFFF'>On&#160;February 27, 2026, the Board of Directors approved the dismissal of FRUCI &amp; ASSOCIATES II, PLLC , and the appointment of PG Accountants LLC (&quot;PG&quot;) as the Company's new independent registered public accounting firm, effective immediately, to perform independent audit services for the fiscal year ending April 30, 2026.&#160;&#160;During the two fiscal years ended April 30, 2025 and through February 27, 2026, neither the Company, nor anyone on its behalf, consulted PG regarding either (i) the application of accounting principles to a specified transaction, either completed or proposed, or the type of audit opinion that might be rendered with respect to the financial statements of the Company, and no written report or oral advice was provided to the Company by PG that was an important factor considered by the Company in reaching a decision as to any accounting, auditing or financial reporting issue; or (ii) any matter that was the subject of a &quot;disagreement&quot; (as defined in Item 304(a)(1)(iv) of Regulation S-K and the related instructions) or a &#8220;reportable event&#8221; (as that term is defined in Item 304(a)(1)(v) of Regulation S-K).</P>
